title: Nutanix CEO Rajiv Ramaswami announces plans to step down and become a senior adviser, but will remain as CEO until a successor is named; he joined in late 2020 (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: Nutanix CEO Rajiv Ramaswami announces plans to step down and become a senior adviser, but will remain as CEO until a successor is named; he joined in late 2020 — Rajiv Ramaswami is stepping down from his role as the Chief Executive Officer of Nutanix Inc., six years after he joined …
